2.t: ˹All will be resurrected,˺ yet the deniers are astonished that a warner has come to them from among themselves ˹warning of resurrection˺. So the disbelievers say, “This is an astonishing thing
2.tr: Bal 'ajibooo an jaa'ahum munzirum minhum faqaalal kaafiroona haazaa shai'un 'ajeeb

3.t: ˹Will we be returned to life,˺ when we are dead and reduced to dust? Such a return is impossible.”
3.tr: A-izaa mitnaa Wa-kunnaa turaaban zaalika raj'um ba'eed

4.t: We certainly know what the earth consumes of them ˹after their death˺, and with us is a well-preserved Record
4.tr: Qad 'alimnaa maa tanqu-sul ardu minhum Wa-'indanaa Kitaabun Hafeez

5.t: In fact, they reject the truth when it has come to them, so they are in a confused state
5.tr: Bal kazzaboo bilhaqqi lammaa jaaa'ahum fahum feee amrim mareej

6.t: Have they not then looked at the sky above them: how We built it and adorned it ˹with stars˺, leaving it flawless
6.tr: Afalam yanzurooo ilas samaaa'i fawqahum kaifa banainaahaa Wa-zaiyannaahaa Wa-maa lahaa min furooj

7.t: As for the earth, We spread it out and placed upon it firm mountains, and produced in it every type of pleasant plant—
7.tr: Wal-arda madadnaahaa Wa-alqainaa feehaa rawaasiya Wa-ambatnaa feehaa min kulli zawjim baheej

8.t: ˹all as˺ an insight and a reminder to every servant who turns ˹to Allah˺

9.t: And We send down blessed rain from the sky, bringing forth gardens and grains for harvest
9.tr: Wa-nazzalnaa minas samaaa'i maaa'am mubaarakan fa-ambatnaa bihee jannaatinw Wa-habbal haseed

10.t: and towering palm trees ˹loaded˺ with clustered fruit

11.t: ˹as˺ a provision for ˹Our˺ servants. And with this ˹rain˺ We revive a lifeless land. Similar is the emergence ˹from the graves˺
11.tr: Rizqal lil'ibaad, Wa-ahyainaa bihee baldatam maitaa; kazaalikal khurooj

12.t: Before them, the people of Noah denied ˹the truth,˺ as did the people of the Water-pit, Thamûd
12.tr: Kazzabat qablahum qawmu Noohinw Wa-Ashaabur Rassi Wa-Samood

14.t: the residents of the Forest, and the people of Tubba’. Each rejected ˹their˺ messenger, so My warning was fulfilled
14.tr: Wa-Ashaabul Aykati Wa-qawmu Tubba'; kullun kazzabar Rusula fahaqqa wa'eed

15.t: Were We incapable of creating ˹them˺ the first time? In fact, they are in doubt about ˹their˺ re-creation
15.tr: Afa'a-yeenaa bilkhalqil awwal; bal hum fee labsim min khalqin jadeed

16.t: Indeed, ˹it is˺ We ˹Who˺ created humankind and ˹fully˺ know what their souls whisper to them, and We are closer to them than ˹their˺ jugular vein
16.tr: Wa-laqad khalaqnal insaana Wa-na'lamu maa tuwaswisu bihee nafsuhoo Wa-Nahnu aqrabu ilaihi min hablil wareed

17.t: As the two recording-angels—˹one˺ sitting to the right, and ˹the other to˺ the left—note ˹everything˺
17.tr: Iz yatalaqqal mutalaqqi-yaani 'anil yameeni Wa-'anish shimaali qa'eed

18.t: not a word does a person utter without having a ˹vigilant˺ observer ready ˹to write it down˺
18.tr: Maa yalfizu min qawlin illaa ladaihi raqeebun 'ateed

19.t: ˹Ultimately,˺ with the throes of death will come the truth. This is what you were trying to escape
19.tr: Wa-jaaa'at sakratul mawti bilhaqq; zaalika maa kunta minhu taheed

20.t: And the Trumpet will be blown. This is the Day ˹you were˺ warned of
20.tr: Wa-nufikha fis Soor; zaalika yawmul wa'eed

21.t: Each soul will come forth with an angel to drive it and another to testify
21.tr: Wa-jaaa'at kullu nafsim ma'ahaa saaa'iqunw Wa-shaheed

22.t: ˹It will be said to the denier,˺ “You were totally heedless of this. Now We have lifted this veil of yours, so Today your sight is sharp!”
22.tr: Laqad kunta fee ghaf-latim min haazaa fakashafnaa 'anka ghitaaa'aka fabasarukal yawma hadeed

23.t: And one’s accompanying-angel will say, “Here is the record ready with me.”

24.t: ˹It will be said to both angels,˺ “Throw into Hell every stubborn disbeliever

25.t: withholder of good, transgressor, and doubter

26.t: who set up another god with Allah. So cast them into the severe punishment.”
26.tr: Allazee ja'ala ma'al laahi ilaahan aakhara fa-alqiyaahu fil 'azaabish shadeed

27.t: One’s ˹devilish˺ associate will say, “Our Lord! I did not make them transgress. Rather, they were far astray ˹on their own˺.”
27.tr: Qaala qareenuhoo Rabbanaa maaa atghaituhoo Wa-laakin kaana fee dalaalin ba'eed

28.t: Allah will respond, “Do not dispute in My presence, since I had already given you a warning
28.tr: Qaala laa takhtasimoo ladaayya Wa-qad qaddamtu ilaikum bilwa'eed

29.t: My Word cannot be changed, nor am I unjust to ˹My˺ creation.”
29.tr: Maa yubaddalul qawlu ladaiya Wa-maaa ana bizal-laamil lil'abeed

30.t: ˹Beware of˺ the Day We will ask Hell, “Are you full ˹yet˺?” And it will respond, “Are there any more?”
30.tr: Yawma naqoolu li'jahannama halim talaati Wa-taqoolu hal mim mazeed

31.t: And Paradise will be brought near to the righteous, not far off

32.t: ˹And it will be said to them,˺ “This is what you were promised, for whoever ˹constantly˺ turned ˹to Allah˺ and kept up ˹His commandments˺—
32.tr: Haaza maa too'adoona likulli awwaabin hafeez

33.t: who were in awe of the Most Compassionate without seeing ˹Him˺, and have come with a heart turning ˹only to Him˺
33.tr: Man khashiyar Rahmaana bilghaibi Wa-jaaa'a biqalbim muneeb

34.t: Enter it in peace. This is the Day of eternal life!”

35.t: There they will have whatever they desire, and with Us is ˹even˺ more
35.tr: Lahum maa yashaaa'oona feehaa Wa-ladainaa mazeed

36.t: ˹Imagine˺ how many peoples We destroyed before them, who were far mightier than them. Then ˹when the torment came,˺ they ˹desperately˺ sought refuge in the land. ˹But˺ was there any escape
36.tr: Wa-kam ahlaknaa qablahum min qarnin hum ashaddu minhum batshan fanaqqaboo fil bilaad, hal mim mahees

37.t: Surely in this is a reminder for whoever has a ˹mindful˺ heart and lends an attentive ear
37.tr: Inna fee zaalika lazikraa liman kaana lahoo qalbun aw alqas sam'a Wa-huwa shaheed

38.t: Indeed, We created the heavens and the earth and everything in between in six Days, and We were not ˹even˺ touched with fatigue
38.tr: Wa-laqad khalaqnas samaawaati wal-arda Wa-maa bainahumaa fee sittati ayyaamin Wa-maa massanaa mil lughoob

39.t: So be patient ˹O Prophet˺ with what they say. And glorify the praises of your Lord before sunrise and before sunset
39.tr: Fasbir 'alaa maa yaqooloona Wa-sabbih bihamdi Rabbika qabla tuloo'ish shamsi Wa-qablal ghuroob

40.t: And glorify Him during part of the night and after the prayers

41.t: And listen! On the Day the caller will call out from a near place
41.tr: Wastami' yawma yunaa-dil munaadi mim makaanin qareeb

42.t: the Day all will hear the ˹mighty˺ Blast in ˹all˺ truth, that will be the Day of emergence ˹from the graves˺
42.tr: Yawma yasmaoonas sai-hata bilhaqq zaalika yawmul khurooj

43.t: It is certainly We Who give life and cause death. And to Us is the final return
43.tr: Innaa Nahnu nuhyee Wa-numeetu Wa-ilainal maseer

44.t: ˹Beware of˺ the Day the earth will split open, letting them rush forth. That will be an easy gathering for Us
44.tr: Yawma tashaqqaqul ardu 'anhum siraa'aa; zaalika hashrun 'alainaa yaseer

45.t: We know best what they say. And you ˹O Prophet˺ are not ˹there˺ to compel them ˹to believe˺. So remind with the Quran ˹only˺ those who fear My warning
45.tr: Nahnu a'lamu bimaa yaqooloona Wa-maaa anta 'alaihim bijabbaarin fazakkir bil-quraani maien yakhaafu wa'eed
